description: This class implements a strategy for handling the RetrieveConnectionLogs command within the connectivity messaging persistence layer. It extends a generic strategy and overrides the method to specify the connection action.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsStrategy
classes.description: A final class that defines a specific strategy for retrieving connection logs by extending the AbstractSingleActionStrategy with the RetrieveConnectionLogs command.

methods.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with the RetrieveConnectionLogs command class.

methods.name: getAction
